name: me.proton.core.devicemigration.presentation.qr.EdmQrCaptureActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when device migration needs to scan a pairing QR code. It uses the camera to read the code and can return a request for manual entry.
disableEffect: If disabled, QR-based device pairing may not work and the migration flow may not complete.
